answer: Cap the number of new identities each epoch and sell the slots by auction, so a Sybil farm cannot mint identities for free: every slot is a jade token won with a bid that is burned, not refunded, making each fake name carry real cost. A raven courier network then verifies each winner's first jobs, with couriers chosen at random and rotated, so no farm can bribe one clique to certify thousands. Standing renews only through fresh work, and any duplicate sends a ripple of slashing through every identity that vouched for it, so mass-producing clones costs more than honest work pays.
